description_en: Queries the list of API security risks

name: DescribeApisecAbnormals

parameters.help_en:
The name of the field used for sorting. Valid values:
discoverTime: the time when the risk was first detected. This is the default value.
abnormalLevel: the risk level.
latestDiscoverTime: the time when the risk was most recently detected
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段的名称。取值：
discoverTime：表示风险首次检出时间（默认）。
abnormalLevel：表示风险等级。
latestDiscoverTime：表示风险最近检出时间
parameters.name: order_key

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
desc: descending order. This is the default value.
asc: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序的方式。取值：
desc：表示降序（默认）。
asc：表示升序
parameters.name: order_way

parameters.help_en:
The risk level. Valid values:
high: high risk.
medium: medium risk.
low: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
风险等级。取值：
high：表示高危。
medium：表示中危。
low：表示低危
parameters.name: abnormal_level

parameters.help_en:
The risk type.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html operation to query the supported risk types
parameters.help_zh:
风险类型。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2859155.html获取支持的风险类型
parameters.name: abnormal_tag

parameters.help_en:
The risk status. Valid values:
toBeConfirmed: to be confirmed.
confirmed: confirmed.
toBeFixed: to be fixed.
fixed: fixed (manually verified).
ignored: ignored.
toBeVerified: to be verified by the system.
notFixed: not fixed after verification.
systemFixed: fixed (verified by the system)
parameters.help_zh:
风险状态。取值：
toBeConfirmed：表示待确认。
confirmed：表示已确认。
toBeFixed：表示待修复。
fixed：表示已修复（人工验证）。
ignored：表示忽略。
toBeVerified：表示待系统验证。
notFixed：表示验证未修复。
systemFixed：表示已修复（系统验证）
parameters.name: user_status

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page

parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The source of the risk type. Valid values:
custom: custom.

default：表示内置

response: the response example.
param: the request parameters
